title: An Oil Rig Drilled Into A Mine. The Whole Lake Vanished 🌀
caption:
An oil rig made a whole lake disappear 🌀
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In November 1980 a drilling rig on Lake Peigneur in Louisiana punctured a salt mine below. The lake drained into the mine within hours, swallowing the rig and barges in a whirlpool, and a canal flowed backwards. Everyone escaped.
Whose fault was it? 👇
first_comment: Wrong spot, one drill, and a whole lake went down the plughole. Who pays for THAT? 🌀👇
